caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher centered on a plain, off-white background. The pitcher is bulbous in shape with a narrow neck, a rounded body, and a single curved handle attached to the side. The body of the pitcher is primarily a light cream or beige color, with subtle shading to indicate its rounded form and reflective surface. Decorative elements on the pitcher include a blue horizontal band near the base, a blue floral motif on the side, and a wide blue stripe with geometric patterns around the rim. The handle is also lightly accented with blue. In the lower right corner of the drawing, there is a small, lightly sketched diagram of the pitcher in pencil, noting measurements labeled as "H" for height and "K" for another dimension, with corresponding arrows. The rest of the background is left blank, providing contrast to the detailed illustration of the pitcher.
title: Cream Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
